related.title: 原子力顯微鏡
related.transfer: 可遷移「量子穿隧與指數距離靈敏度」與「橫向與垂直尺度校正與熱漂移」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；原子力顯微鏡的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Quantum tunneling and exponential distance sensitivity" and "Lateral and vertical scale calibration and thermal drift" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Atomic force microscopes must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦穿隧電流指數律、壓電掃描、隔振與雜訊預算的原子級量測工程；原子力顯微鏡則以懸臂力感測、光槓桿偵測、動態模式、彈簧常數校正與皮米級雜訊預算為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on tunneling exponential law, piezo scanning, vibration isolation and noise budgets for atomic-scale metrology; Atomic force microscopes centres on cantilever force sensing, optical-lever detection, dynamic modes, spring-constant calibration and picometre noise budgets, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「探針—樣品穿隧接面」與「懸臂—探針—表面作用力」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到原子力顯微鏡，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「熱雜訊與偵測器雜訊預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Tip–sample tunneling junction” and “Cantilever–tip–surface force”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Atomic force microscopes, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Thermal and detector noise budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 掃描穿隧顯微鏡
history.text: 1981 年 Gerd Binnig 與 Heinrich Rohrer 在 IBM 蘇黎世研究實驗室建成第一台掃描穿隧顯微鏡，1983 年拍到 Si(111)-7×7 重構的真實空間影像，兩人因此獲得 1986 年諾貝爾物理獎；1990 年 IBM 的 Don Eigler 用低溫 STM 搬動單一 Xe 原子，證明探針也能操控原子。1990 年代起超高真空低溫 STM 商品化，液氦槽式系統成為表面物理與穿隧能譜的標準平台。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In 1981 Gerd Binnig and Heinrich Rohrer built the first scanning tunneling microscope at IBM Research in Zurich, imaged the Si(111)-7×7 reconstruction in real space in 1983 and shared the 1986 Nobel Prize in Physics; in 1990 Don Eigler at IBM used a low-temperature STM to position single Xe atoms, showing that the tip can also manipulate matter. Ultrahigh-vacuum low-temperature STMs became commercial products from the 1990s, and helium-bath systems are now the standard platform for surface physics and tunneling spectroscopy. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「量子穿隧與指數距離靈敏度」到「系統驗收、基準樣品與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Quantum tunneling and exponential distance sensitivity" through "System acceptance, reference samples and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
